class.name: IfcStructuralPlanarAction
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a surface. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2. IFC 2x4 change: Intermediate supertype IfcStructuralSurfaceAction inserted. Derived attribute PredefinedType added. NOTE Like its supertype IfcStructuralSurfaceAction , this action type may also act on curved faces.
